author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The New York Yankees moved to the edge of a playoff berth Sunday by shutting out the New York Mets 2-0 in the final game of the season’s Subway Series, Reuters reported.
Cam Schlittler held the Mets to one hit over six innings and struck out eight. His performance lowered his major-league-leading earned-run average to 1.949, according to the report.
Ben Rice and Austin Wells each hit a solo home run for New York. The Yankees have won 18 of their last 26 games, and their magic number to clinch a postseason place is now one.

The victory gave the Yankees another strong finish in a rivalry series that draws attention across the region. New York can secure its playoff spot with one more win or with a loss by the team directly behind it in the standings, depending on the league’s remaining results.
The report remains subject to further verified updates as officials continue reviewing the circumstances.
dek: The Yankees beat the Mets 2-0 in the final Subway Series game Sunday, moving within one win of securing a postseason spot.
headline: Yankees move closer to playoff berth with 2-0 win over Mets
